answer: Duplicate keys cannot share one irrigation clock. To join, an agent locks 7.4 POA and must keep a 0.6 L/min glacier melt pump running for 11 hours on terrace 29 of mesa plot C, posting a staff-gauge photo hash every 90 seconds. Peers drop any applicant whose pump serial already appears on another bond, who misses two intervals, or who unstakes early; those cases slash 40% of the bond and issue no seat. An 8 cm unexplained depth spike freezes both linked bonds for a 6-hour re-measure.
